description: Unit tests for the DirectoryLister class in the net namespace, including setup of temporary directory structures and various test cases for directory listing behavior.

classes.name: ListerDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class for handling directory listing callbacks, managing sorting, cancellation, and result collection.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Creates a nested directory and file structure of depth 3 with specified files per directory for testing.

methods.name: root_path
methods.description: Returns the root path of the temporary directory structure.

methods.name: expected_list_length_recursive
methods.description: Calculates the expected number of files/directories listed in recursive mode.

methods.name: expected_list_length_non_recursive
methods.description: Calculates the expected number of files/directories listed in non-recursive mode.
